name: 美國 ISM 製造業 PMI
text: The ISM Manufacturing PMI edged down to 54.5 in September 2026 from 54.6 in August, compared to forecasts of 55. Still, the reading continued to point to robust growth in the manufacturing sector, with new orders (55.3 vs 53.7) and employment (52.7 vs 51.2) rising at a faster pace while production slowed slightly (56.7 vs 58.3).

name: 美國 ISM 服務業 PMI
text: The ISM Services PMI fell to 54.9 in September 2026 from 55.4 in August, compared with expectations of 55. The index nevertheless remained in expansion territory for a 27th consecutive month, indicating continued growth in the US services sector.

name: 台灣製造業 PMI
text: The S&P Global Taiwan Manufacturing PMI rose to 56.7 in September 2026 from 54.7 in August, marking its strongest reading since August 2021. Output and new orders expanded at their fastest rates in over five years, supported by stronger domestic and overseas demand, particularly for AI-related products.

name: CPI 年增率
text: The US annual inflation rate accelerated to 3.7% in September 2026, up from 3.4% in each of the previous two months and above market expectations of 3.6%, driven by higher energy prices. Gasoline rose 34.2% yoy, more than 27.4% in August and fuel oil prices increased 74.2%, compared with 52% previously.

name: CPI 月增率
text: US consumer prices rose 0.6% month-on-month in September 2026, accelerating from 0.4% in August, in line with expectations and marking the largest monthly increase since April. The energy index surged 5.2%, following a 2.1% rise in August, driven largely by a 9.1% jump in gasoline prices, which accounted for more than half of the overall CPI increase.

name: 核心 CPI 年增率
text: The US core inflation rate, excluding volatile food and fuel costs, rose to 2.6% in September 2026 from a five-year low of 2.4% in August, slightly exceeding the expected 2.5%. The heavyweight shelter index increased 3.2% over the last year.

name: 核心 CPI 月增率
text: Core consumer prices in the United States, which exclude food and energy, rose by 0.3% from the previous month in September of 2026, the same pace as August, and ahead of median market expectations of a 0.2% increase. Consumer prices rose sharply for shelter (0.4% vs 0.3% in August) and transportation services (0.6% vs 0.5%), the most in six months to suggest that soaring energy prices are being transmitted through the transportation and logistics sector.

name: PPI 年增率
text: Producer prices in the United States surged by 6.3% from the previous year in September of 2026, the most since December of 2022, and well above market expectations of 5.3%. It was an increase from the upwardly revised, 5.6% increase in the previous month.

name: PPI 月增率
text: Producer prices in the United States soared by 1.3% from the previous month in September of 2026, the sharpest increase since the start of the Russian invasion of Ukraine in March of 2022, and the second highest increase on record. It was sharply above market expectations of a 0.5% increase, as the global energy shock from the war in the Middle East drove energy costs for US producers to gain 10.8% on the month, which in turn drove transportation and warehousing (3.4%) and trade (1.4%) costs to rise.

name: 核心 PPI 年增率
text: Core producer price inflation in the United States, which exclude food and energy goods, rose to 5% in September 2026 from an upwardly revised 4.8% in August, above market expectations of 4.4%. It is the highest since January 2023.

name: PCE 年增率
text: US PCE inflation held at 3.4% year-on-year in August 2026, unchanged from a downwardly revised July reading and below market expectations of 3.7%. Core PCE inflation, which excludes food and energy, also held steady at 3.0%.

name: 核心 PCE 年增率
text: The US core PCE price index, the Federal Reserve's preferred measure of underlying inflation, increased 3% year-on-year in August 2026, coming in below the 3.3% rise expected by markets. The latest reading followed a downward revision to July's figure, with the annual increase now estimated at 3%, compared with the previously reported 3.3%.

name: 核心 PCE 月增率
text: The US core PCE price index, the Federal Reserve's preferred measure of underlying inflation, increased 0.2% month-on-month in August 2026, coming in below the 0.3% rise expected by markets. The latest reading followed a downward revision to July's figure, with the monthly increase now estimated at 0.1%, compared with the previously reported 0.2%.

name: 個人消費支出月增率
text: US personal consumption expenditures increased by $190.8 billion, or 0.9%, in August 2026, the most since March, exceeding expectations for a 0.8% rise and accelerating from a downwardly revised 0.1% gain in July. Goods spending rose $114.1 billion, driven by higher spending on nondurable goods, including other nondurable goods (up $24.7 billion), gasoline and other energy goods (up $20.9 billion), and food and beverages (up $11.6 billion), while durable goods spending increased $48 billion.

name: 失業率
text: The US unemployment rate rose to 4.2% in September 2026, up from 4.1% in August and slightly above market expectations of 4.1%. The number of unemployed increased by 78,000 to 7.11 million, while total employment surged by 406,000 to 163.15 million.

name: 非農就業人數
text: The US economy added 29K jobs in September 2026, following a downwardly revised 133K in August and well below forecasts of 90K. Increases were seen in health care employment (17K), mostly ambulatory health care services (13K) and in hospitals (12K); construction (11K) and manufacturing (9K), mostly plastics and rubber products (5K) and machinery (5K).

name: 聯準會利率決策
text: The Federal Reserve left the federal funds rate unchanged at 3.75%–4.00% at its October 2026 meeting, following a 25bps hike in September, which was the first rate increase since 2023. The decision came in line with market expectations but two policymakers voted for a 25bps rate hike.
